PLAN "12-Week Moderate Cardiac-Safe General Fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general strength and conditioning safely"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full body A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Cardio & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycling 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x60..60 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds

          walking 5m
